newsitem.title: NORWAY: Troll to supply first Norway gas-fired power plant.
newsitem.headline: Troll to supply first Norway gas-fired power plant.

text.p: Licensees of the Troll gas field have signed a contract for deliveries of 500 million cubic metres of gas per year with Naturkraft, operator of Norway's first gas-fired power stations, Den norske stats oljeselskap AS (Statoil) said on Thursday.
Two gas-fed stations -- at Kollsnes and Kaarstoe both on the west coast of the country -- are planned for the oil-rich country, which relies entirely on hydropower for electricity production.

Statoil's Status Weekly newsletter said supplies to the plant would begin flowing on October 1, 1999. The plant will be built just east of the Kollsnes gas treatment facility. A 30-year lease has been secured for the site.
Naturkraft was set up specifically for the gas plant project and is a joint venture between Norsk Hydro ASA, Norway's largest electricity producer Statkraft A/S and Statoil.
